/**
 * Option lists for the nine-field EDU2JOB 2.0 profile form.
 *
 * PROVISIONAL: the definitive category vocabularies come from the new
 * model's training data (edu2job_dataset.csv) and are delivered with the
 * model artifacts via ml_models/v2/model_metadata.json. Once those are
 * confirmed, trim/extend these lists to match — the Flask service enforces
 * the metadata vocabularies authoritatively and returns a clear 400 for
 * anything unsupported, so the form can never silently feed the model an
 * unknown category.
 */export const DEGREE_OPTIONS=['B.Tech','B.E.','B.Sc','B.Com','BBA','BCA','B.A.','M.Tech','M.Sc','M.Com','MBA','MCA','Other'];export const MAJOR_OPTIONS=['Computer Science','Information Technology','Artificial Intelligence','Data Science','Electronics','Mechanical Engineering','Civil Engineering','Electrical Engineering','Business Administration','Finance','Accounting','Commerce','Marketing','Economics','Human Resources','Psychology','Mathematics','Physics','Other'];export const SKILL_SUGGESTIONS=[// Technical
'Python','Java','JavaScript','SQL','Data Structures','Machine Learning','Data Analysis','HTML','CSS','React','Excel','Cloud Computing',// Non-technical
'Communication','Leadership','Business Analysis','Financial Analysis','Marketing','Sales','Project Management','Human Resources','Documentation','Negotiation','Research'];export const CERTIFICATION_OPTIONS=['AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner','Microsoft Azure Fundamentals','Google Data Analytics','Oracle Java Certification','Cisco CCNA','NPTEL Certification'];export const COMMUNICATION_OPTIONS=['Beginner','Intermediate','Advanced'];export const INTERNSHIP_OPTIONS=[{value:'Yes',label:'Yes — I have internship experience'},{value:'No',label:'No — not yet'}];/** The nine model fields, in contract order. */export const PROFILE_FIELDS=['degree','major','cgpa','skills','certification_name','internship_experience','projects_count','communication_skill','experience_months'];export const EMPTY_PROFILE={degree:'',major:'',cgpa:'',skills:[],certification_name:'',internship_experience:'',projects_count:'',communication_skill:'',experience_months:''};/** Count filled fields (0–9) for the profile-completion indicator. */export function profileCompletion(profile){if(!profile)return 0;let filled=0;if(profile.degree)filled+=1;if(profile.major)filled+=1;if(profile.cgpa!==''&&profile.cgpa!==null&&profile.cgpa!==undefined)filled+=1;if(Array.isArray(profile.skills)&&profile.skills.length>0)filled+=1;if(profile.certification_name)filled+=1;if(profile.internship_experience)filled+=1;if(profile.projects_count!==''&&profile.projects_count!==null&&profile.projects_count!==undefined)filled+=1;if(profile.communication_skill)filled+=1;if(profile.experience_months!==''&&profile.experience_months!==null&&profile.experience_months!==undefined)filled+=1;return filled;}
